<function name="GetKeepAspect" parent="DImage" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Returns whether the <page>DImage</page> should keep the aspect ratio of its image when being resized.

See <page>DImage:SetKeepAspect</page> for more info on how it works.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether the <page>DImage</page> should keep the aspect ratio of its image when being resized.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
